errors.evidence: The description describes the share of the yellow slice ('Консултант/Надзор') as a 'small part' but fails to provide an approximate percentage. The value can be visually estimated to be around 5% or calculated as 4.8% (100 - 14.3 - 33.3 - 47.6), which is a key piece of information missing.

errors.evidence: The description incorrectly claims that the segments are ordered by descending size. The actual order of slices, going clockwise, is 14.3%, 33.3%, approx. 4.8%, and 47.6%, which does not follow a size-based ordering.
